title: Spicy Gyoza Laksa-style Soup
method: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion and red cabbage from the stir fry pack; fry for 2 minutes.
Add laksa paste and fry, stirring, for 2-3 minutes. Pour in coconut milk and chicken stock; simmer gently for 8 minutes.
Cook the chicken gyoza and udon noodles according to pack instructions, then divide between 2 large bowls.
Add the remaining stir fry vegetables (except coriander) to the broth and simmer for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Ladle broth and vegetables over the noodles and gyoza, garnish with coriander, and serve.
